routers.description: HTTP routers: match a request rule and forward to a service.

rule.description: Match rule, e.g. Host(`example.com`) or PathPrefix(`/api`).

service.description: Name of the service (below) to forward to.

entrypoint.description: Entrypoint name from the static config (e.g. web or websecure).

tls.description: Serve this router over TLS (Traefik can auto-provision via its certResolver).

services.description: Backend services each router forwards to.
